It seems the function changes the line from `test[test](#` to `#`. This is strange.

> It seems the function changes the line from `test[test](#` to `#`. This is strange.

That seems to be done by `complete_add()`.

Minimal repro:
```vim
set completeopt=longest

func Complete(findstart, base) abort
  if a:findstart
    let col = col('.')
    call complete_add('#')
    return col - 1
  else
    return []
  endif
endfunc

set completefunc=Complete
call setline(1, 'foo#')
call feedkeys("A\<C-X>\<C-U>")
```

This doesn't crash without ASAN, but causes an ASAN failure.

Nice work finding a minimal example @zeertzjq. I was trying to do this yesterday but couldn't find a small one with the same crash. But I didn't but the `complete_add` inside the first call to `Complete`, I wonder if that's what causes the issue.

Actually the minimal example does not crash `nvim` for me, does it for you?
I said it doesn't crash. It just causes an ASAN failure. You can see an invalid read when using valgrind too.

I think `complete_add()` should only be used when completion has started. The completion hasn't started yet on the first invocation of `'completefunc'`, so I think the plugin isn't calling `complete_add()` correctly.

> I said it doesn't crash

My bad

>  so I think the plugin isn't calling `complete_add()` correctly.

Agreed, but a crash still should't happen I guess?

> Agreed, but a crash still should't happen I guess?

Yes, but even if this crash is fixed, this usage will still lead to an error `E840`, which should be Vim's behavior.

issue.title: fix(autoload) call complete_add only on second call to completefunc

repository.name: mkdx
repository.description: A vim plugin that adds some nice extra's for working with markdown documents

issue.body: Closes #159 and also avoids the crashig `nvim` due to https://github.com/neovim/neovim/issues/17489

body: I can confirm that not calling `complete_add` in the first call to `completefunc` fixes the issue of the plugin. See https://github.com/SidOfc/mkdx/pull/160 for a fix.

issue.title: vim-patch:8.2.{3949,3950}: fix two crashes with /\%V

repository.name: neovim
repository.description: Vim-fork focused on extensibility and usability

issue.body:
Fix #17489

#### vim-patch:8.2.3949: using freed memory with /\\%V

Problem:    Using freed memory with /\\%V.
Solution:   Get the line again after getvvcol().
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/4c13e5e6763c6eb36a343a2b8235ea227202e952


#### vim-patch:8.2.3950: going beyond the end of the line with /\\%V

Problem:    Going beyond the end of the line with /\\%V.
Solution:   Check for valid column in getvcol().
https://github.com/vim/vim/commit/94f3192b03ed27474db80b4d3a409e107140738b
